title: Weight-layout remapper and fused-attention fastpath for INT8/FP8 kernels
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Add a weight-layout remapping layer and a fused-attention fastpath to reduce dequant/cast overhead for INT8 and FP8 serving. The goal is a zero-copy path from packed weight storage -> attention GEMM -> fused softmax/scale with minimal host-side dequant, lowering per-token latency and improving throughput under the continuous-batching prefill/decode schedule.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Kickoff: scoped to V1 fastpath for causal attention only (no cross-attention). Deliverables: layout remapper, kernel wrapper, small runtime policy to route to fastpath when model layout matches. Linked PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Weight+Layout+Remapper

2026-02-25 - Spike results (local A100 single-GPU): microbenchmarks show 18% median latency reduction on 1k token context with 16-token decode bursts when using fused-attn INT8 path vs baseline dequant+attention (baseline: 14.2ms, fastpath: 11.7ms). Throughput improvement ~12% for batch sizes 4-8. Bench artifacts: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/r/bench/ENG-482199

2026-03-02 - Design review with ML infra and numerical QA: discussed quantization scale propagation, per-head scale vs per-tensor scale trade-offs. Decision: implement per-head scale in remapper for H100 targets and fall back to per-tensor for older GPUs to reduce memory overhead. Notes: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/REMAPPING-DESIGN

2026-03-05 - Engineering update: landed kernel wrapper and weight remap prototype. Created synthetic validation harness and integrated with existing continuous-batching prefill scheduler to exercise KV cache interactions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345

2026-03-08 - QA: ran prompt-level quality checks across 50 eval prompts comparing FP16 baseline vs INT8 fastpath. Small 0.6% BLEU-style drift observed on some edge cases (rare numeric instability with extreme scale ratios). Action: add a dynamic sanity check that disables fastpath on per-request if scale ratio > 8x and route to mixed-precision fallback.

2026-03-10 - Ops note: added telemetry to measure fastpath hit-rate and per-request fallback reasons. Dashboard panels: fastpath_hit_rate, fallback_reasons, median_decode_latency_fastpath. Will run canary on 5% of production Hosted traffic behind a feature flag (console rollout).
